units.translation: What pain creeps under my ribs?
What honor remains for me?
What misfortune has struck?
For whose error's penalties does he destroy?
By whose message's report?
By whose man is this grief brought about?
Whose man ever?
From what word?
You there, what are you doing? With what thought do you dishonor this city?
Desiring what food?
For the sake of what harm did you kill my child?
In what way?
In what way does he fight as an ally?
What penalty do you see present?
What misfortune do you say came upon the army?
What toil does the city toil?
What other then shall I add to this faction?
What cry do you hear in the house?
What seat do you say I have?
To what kinder land then could we come than this?
What other offspring of this land do you speak of?
What voice will you utter?
What path could they cut as a release from marriage?
What opportunity do you teach me?
What visions whirl you about?
What rustling sound do I hear?
What is it?
What race?
What remedy for the disease?
What gain is there for me in living?
What new thing is there again for the city?
What else but toils upon the hearth of the house?
What else besides these?
What new heavy evil is there for the Persians?
What need? What news?
Why not groaning, not obtaining, a portion of the day?
For what light is sweeter for a woman to see than this?
What is this new great grief?
What too piercing word have you uttered?
What hateful creature could I call her?
What is the matter?
What evil have you tasted?
What thing do I see?
For what ransom is there for blood fallen to the ground?
What is the matter?
What deed have you done?
What else did he do?
What name then will mortals give them?
For what life is good that brings pains?
For what relish could be better for this man?
Why do you delay and lament in vain? Why do you not hate the god most hateful to the gods?
Why then do you delay?
Why do we delay?
Why do you delay?
Why do I delay to see the divine mind?
Why must we lament these things?
Why must we speak of those destroyed in the vote?
Why need you tell me the greater things?
Why need of sleeping women?
And why need to speak?
Why need I tell you the name?
Why do you hate her?
Why does she remain a virgin so long?
What about whom?
Why then have you been reconciled with the sword?
Why have you lamented these things?
Why then do I have this mockery of myself?
Why then do I, pitiable, lament thus?
Why did you not kill this man yourself?
For why should I hide what sort of thing flies in my mind?
Why do you keep the suppliant from the gates?
Why did you not drive her out alive into exile?
Why do you grieve after doing the just thing?
Why do you wait for those more authoritative than these?
What good voyage did they accomplish?
Why do you not come to help?
What? For I declare that the dead fare better than these.
Speak.
What misfortune has struck?
I ordered to send punishments for the father. What else?
In a spurious verse: What else?
Why not?
What then? Did the sailor, fleeing to the prow, find from the stern a means of safety?
Why then should we fawn upon a destructive fate?
